Elena — thanks for the packet and quick turnaround. A couple of items before we can finalize the vendor master entry: 

1) Legal name verification: the onboarding form shows NimbleWorks LLC which is correct, but for our KYC we need either the Articles of Organization (filed with the state) or a government-issued company registration extract that matches the legal name and EIN.

2) Beneficial ownership / UBO confirmation: please provide the name(s) of the >25% beneficial owner(s). A scanned government ID or signed declaration is sufficient.

3) ACH authorization: our AP team requires a vendor-signed ACH authorization form (simple one-page) naming the account and confirming permission to be paid by Redwood Inference.

If you can drop the Articles_of_Organization_NimbleWorks.pdf and a signed ACH authorization back into this thread I can route to AP and mark the vendor as approved.

For PO mapping: once the vendor is created we will return a vendor code and the canonical legal-name-to-ERP mapping. POs should reference the vendor code and the legal entity "NimbleWorks LLC" in the header; invoices should list the same legal name and the invoice remit to the bank details provided. If you have an AP email distribution list, please include that on invoices to speed reconciliation.

Cc'ing Marissa (Vendor Master) to pick this up once docs are in.

Best,
